narrative:
Lyndhurst municipal court district has 43,403 registered voters, with 52.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 14.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 33.2%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 19.1 percentage points. Registration is trending redder in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +10.9% D−R vs +20.1% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
